newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic coronary stent released in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic coronary stent released in Europe.

text.p: Medtronic Inc said Thursday a new coronary stent, the beStent, was released in Europe and other world markets.

"Release of the beStent in markets outside the United States is Medtronic's next step in offering interventional cardiologists a full choice of balloon-expandable and self-expanding stents," B. Kristine Johnson, president of Medtronic's Vascular Business, said in a statement. "We foresee different clinical requirements being satisfied by each type of coronary stent, and we intend to provide a full product line in each segment."

Coronary stents are increasingly used by interventional cardiologists to support walls of arteries on the surface of the heart after their blood passageways have been widened with balloon catheters in a therapy known as percutaneous transluminal coronary angioplasty.
